messages.subject: Kingsmoor - title/lease review notes
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

First pass on title and leases:
- Title absolute, Seller registered proprietor, old Clydesford charge discharged (DS1 on file). Clean.
- WAULT c.5.1 yrs / 3.9 to break. Two breaks in 2027-28 (Brookmere, Meridian) - income risk to flag to client.
- Aldermere 3rd floor review due 25 March is OPEN. Agent thinks uplift to c.£205k. We should push for a retention rather than delay exchange.
- Rent deposits: Meridian £138.5k, Halcyon £50k - need assignment on completion.

I'll build these into the report on title. On the contract I'd open the liability cap low (25%) and 12 months notice.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
